data.summary:
Professional 
Seasoned Program Manager and AI enthusiast with extensive experience leading enterprise AI-driven digital transformation programs across Asset & Wealth Management and Payments ecosystems. Expertise in delivering AI/ML analytics platforms, data modernization, and payment innovations including UPI, DCMS, ACS, and cross-border payments, ensuring compliance with RBI and NPCI regulatory frameworks.
Experienced in managing end-to-end AI/ML, Agentic AI lifecycle delivery, Goverance including data engineering, Snowflake data platform migrations, AWS data lakes, advanced analytics, and ESG automation initiatives. Proven ability to translate business problems into AI-driven solutions, enabling improved risk analytics, operational efficiency, and customer insights.
Led large-scale transformation initiatives at M2P Fintech, Fidelity International, and HSBC, delivering Salesforce CRM enhancements, cloud modernization, and scalable analytics platforms that accelerated time-to-market and reduced operational costs.
Strong expertise in Agile and Waterfall program governance, stakeholder management, and cross- functional leadership, utilizing frameworks such as RAID, RACI, OKRs, and enterprise delivery governance to successfully deliver complex AI and fintech programs.
Currently serving as Program Manager at M2P Fintech, with prior experience at Fidelity International, HSBC, Capita, Tech Mahindra, Capgemini, and Mphasis (HP Company) delivering transformation initiatives across financial services, telecom, and technology domains.
Responsibilities
_Change agent at the intersection of Technology, Data strategy and functional/business outcomes. Has driven transformation within wider ecosystem to drive businesses outcomes and develop robust, scalable and performant applications within defined timeline and budget resulting in cost reduction and increase in ROI and Time to market.
_Define vision, objectives and roadmap. Devise Comprehensive Plan, Charter, RAID, RACI for projects with objectives to meet business goals. Budget and cost forecasting. Accountable for ETE Planning, scoping, execution and projects deliverables/artifacts in Agile and waterfall Methodology. Working with Delivery, Engineering, Product, Compliance, Business/ Sponsors teams etc.
_Influencing technology, arhitectural direction and Product Roadmap with understanding of Technology, Industry and Org wide best practices, Frameworks, patterns and Tools.
_Manage and monitor the delivery governance working with cross functional teams and stakeholders across geographies.
_Define KPIs/OKR and success metrics for the projects.
_Use data-driven insights to track progress and optimize performance.
_Program goverance and status reporting at senior governance forums.
_Mentor and coach to build high performing teams.
_Promote Knowledge sharing and skill development.Foster a culture of innovation and operational excellence.
_Led continuous improvement initiatives across projects to enhance efficiency, quality, and stakeholder satisfaction..
_Identify potential risks, issues and dependencies.Develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
_Effectively allocated resources across multiple projects to optimize productivity, reduce bottlenecks, and ensure timely delivery.
